stock.description: Yunnan Energy International Co. Limited, an investment holding company, distributes analytical and laboratory instruments, and life science equipment in the People’s Republic of China, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Distribution Business and Supply Chain Business. It offers analytical instruments, such as medical computed tomography equipment, magnetic resonance imaging systems, fully automated microbial mass spectrometers, digital choledochoscopes, color ultrasound machines, radio frequency therapeutic devices, anesthesia machines, and life monitors, as well as life science and general laboratory instruments with specialized and customized hardware and software to provide solutions and facilitate scientific analysis and testing. It also provides after-sales services, such as testing, training, and maintenance services. In addition, the company engages in trading and supply chain business of construction materials, agricultural products, traditional Chinese medicine products, mineral products, and photovoltaic products. It serves businesses and institutions, which include hospitals, universities, research institutions, and government agencies, as well as companies in the industrial sector. The company was formerly known as Techcomp (Holdings) Limited and changed its name to Yunnan Energy International Co. Limited in December 2018. Yunnan Energy International Co. Limited was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. Yunnan Energy International Co. Limited is a subsidiary of Baodi International Investment Company Ltd.
